desc: Ground pickup reach (scripts/match/pickup_reach.gd, docs/PICKUP_REACH.md). Each rule is a flat radius and a height (m) a hunter must be within, and nothing may stand between them and the thing: a rock, higher ground or a kit wall blocks a pickup as it blocks sight. walk: consumables, armor shards, gems, seeds, Rift and chest keys fly to you as you pass (no key); pull_speed + (radius - distance) x pull_gain m/s, taken when within grab m of your chest, settle s after they land. tune: a weapon tuning taken by walking over it. bot: a bot walking over a tuning or a gear piece better than its own. interact: gear and treasure, taken with the interact key; of several in reach the key takes the one nearest the cursor.
